inputs.title: Abell 1689: Hubble ACS, stars removed
inputs.credit: X-ray: NASA/CXC/MIT/E.-H Peng et al; Optical: NASA/STScI
inputs.acquisition: The publisher's Hubble layer with its stars removed by `node labs/nebula/run.mts remove-stars src/objects/abell-1689-chandra-layers --from=a1689_opt.tif --coarse=4` (NOX over the whole picture, then again over a copy a quarter of the size, 963 x 1000 px, for the saturated stars: 25.86% of the picture took that pass). NOX takes compact light whatever it is: the smaller galaxies went with the Milky Way's stars, the larger ones stay. Not tracked. A display picture, not a calibrated scientific array.
inputs.license: No copyright is asserted on Chandra content (https://chandra.harvard.edu/photo/image_use.html); retain the complete recorded credit.
